INSERT INTO pocketsound_files (
  owner_user_id,
  tg_chat_id,
  message_id,
  file_unique_id,
  title,
  artist,
  file_name,
  duration,
  file_size,
  mime_type,
  file_type,
  thumbnail_file_id,
  uploaded_at,
  created_at
)
VALUES (
  {{ $json.owner_user_id }},
  {{ $json.tg_chat_id }},
  {{ $json.message_id }},
  '{{ $json.file_unique_id }}',
  '{{ $json.title }}',
  '{{ $json.artist }}',
  '{{ $json.file_name }}',
  {{ $json.duration }},
  {{ $json.file_size }},
  '{{ $json.mime_type }}',
  'audio',
  '{{ $json.thumbnail_file_id }}',
  NOW(),
  NOW()
)
ON CONFLICT (file_unique_id) DO NOTHING;

SELECT id, title, artist, file_name  
FROM pocketsound_files  
WHERE file_unique_id = '{{ $node["Prepare File Record"].json.preserved_file_unique_id }}'  
LIMIT 1;

INSERT INTO pocketsound_file_search_index (
  file_id,
  search_text,
  normalized_text
)
VALUES (
  {{ $json.id }},
  '{{ $json.title }} {{ $json.artist }} {{ $json.file_name }}',
  to_tsvector(
    'simple',
    LOWER('{{ $json.title }} {{ $json.artist }} {{ $json.file_name }}')
  )
)
ON CONFLICT (file_id) DO UPDATE
SET
  search_text = EXCLUDED.search_text,
  normalized_text = EXCLUDED.normalized_text;
